description: This file contains implementation of filesystem utility functions for path manipulation, normalization, and directory handling within a build system, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: BuildDirContext
classes.description: Represents the context for build directory paths, including build settings, toolchain label, and whether it is the default toolchain.

methods.name: BuildDirContext
methods.description: Constructors for BuildDirContext with various parameters.

methods.name: GetBuildDirAsSourceDir
methods.description: Returns the build directory as a SourceDir object based on context and type.

methods.name: GetBuildDirAsOutputFile
methods.description: Returns the build directory as an OutputFile object based on context and type.

methods.name: GetSubBuildDirAsSourceDir
methods.description: Returns a subdirectory of the build directory as a SourceDir.

methods.name: GetSubBuildDirAsOutputFile
methods.description: Returns a subdirectory of the build directory as an OutputFile.

methods.name: GetBuildDirForTargetAsSourceDir
methods.description: Gets the build directory for a target as a SourceDir.

methods.name: GetBuildDirForTargetAsOutputFile
methods.description: Gets the build directory for a target as an OutputFile.

methods.name: GetScopeCurrentBuildDirAsSourceDir
methods.description: Gets the current build directory for a scope as a SourceDir.
